description: This file defines a `BufferConverter` class that provides functionality to convert audio buffers between different formats using AVFoundation's AVAudioConverter. It includes error handling and internal helper classes.

classes.name: BufferConverter
classes.description: A class responsible for converting `AVAudioPCMBuffer` instances from one format to another.

classes.name: BufferConverter.Box
classes.description: A helper internal class used for reference semantics in the conversion process, wrapping a generic value with Sendable capability.

classes.name: BufferConverter.ConverterError
classes.description: An enum defining possible errors during the conversion process.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an input `AVAudioPCMBuffer` to a specified `AVAudioFormat`. Handles reinitialization of the converter if needed and manages buffer allocation and error handling.
